about: The ONLYOFFICE Docs release this app takes its editor files from. scripts/upstream-watch.mjs compares it with the newest one every week; change it only together with the bundle built from it.

x2t.about: The converter, x2t, built to WebAssembly by this project from ONLYOFFICE core at the editor files' tag (source_tag): scripts/x2t/build.sh builds it in docker from what "build" names - the toolchain by its digest and one day's Ubuntu snapshot, every source by its commit - and checks the two files against "files"; two builds give the same bytes. scripts/fetch-x2t.mjs takes a build made elsewhere and checks it the same way. Change it only together with a build that gives the new sums.
x2t.from: ONLYOFFICE core v9.4.0.129 (AGPL-3.0), with CryptPad's changes for WebAssembly (github.com/cryptpad/onlyoffice-x2t-wasm, AGPL-3.0-or-later) ported to it and this project's own, all in scripts/x2t/patches/; built the way CryptPad builds its own (emscripten, one qmake project at a time). Release 0.1.0 carried CryptPad's build, v9.3.2+3.

recipe.about: Where scripts/x2t comes from: CryptPad's Dockerfile and embuild.sh at the release commit, and its changes to ONLYOFFICE core (its core/ at the changes commit, against core v9.3.0.140, the commit that core/ was pulled from), ported to source_tag in scripts/x2t/patches/01-cryptpad-wasm.patch.
